lessons.title: एकेकाळी (ekekāḷī) — once upon a time; at one time
lessons.gloss: once upon a time; at one time

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Marathi for at that very moment, then the Marathi for immediately.
एकेकाळी — ekekāḷī — "once upon a time; at one time".
एकेकाळी या डोंगरावर एक मोठा किल्ला होता. ekekāḷī yā ḍoṅgrāvar ek moṭhā killā hotā. Once upon a time there was a big fort on this hill.
Built from एक, one, and काळ, time, with -ई: at one time. Stories open with it.
एकेकाळी (ekekāḷī) is built from ek, 'one', and kāḷ, 'time', which CDIAL lists under Sanskrit kāla, 'time' (CDIAL 3084), in the locative: at one time.
One more word for telling what happened.

lessons.title: कथा (kathā) — a short story; a story

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Marathi for immediately, then the Marathi for once upon a time.
कथा — kathā — "a short story; a story".
आजी रोज रात्री मुलांना एक कथा सांगते. ājī roj rātrī mulānnā ek kathā sāṅgte. Every night Grandma tells the children a story.
Feminine.
Plural कथा (kathā). गोष्ट is the everyday word; कथा (kathā) is the written, literary one.
कथा (kathā) is a tatsama, taken from Sanskrit kathā, 'a talk, a tale' (Monier-Williams).
One more word for telling what happened.

Before the new one: say the Marathi for once upon a time, then the Marathi for a short story.
कहाणी — kahāṇī — "a tale".
त्या जुन्या घराची कहाणी फार दुःखाची आहे. tyā junyā gharācī kahāṇī phār duḥkhācī āhe. The tale of that old house is very sad.
Feminine. Plural: कहाण्या, kahāṇyā.
Plural कहाण्या.
कहाणी (kahāṇī) is a tadbhava: CDIAL lists Marathi kahāṇī, 'a tale', under Sanskrit kathānaka, 'a little tale' (CDIAL 2705).
One more word for telling what happened.

किस्सा — kissā — "an anecdote".
बाबांनी त्यांच्या लहानपणीचा एक मजेदार किस्सा सांगितला. bābānnī tyāñcyā lahānapṇīcā ek majedār kissā sāṅgitlā. Dad told a funny anecdote from his childhood.
Masculine. Plural: किस्से, kisse.
Plural किस्से.
किस्सा (kissā) is a loan from Persian qissa, usually traced to Arabic qiṣṣa, 'a story, a narrative'.
One more word for telling what happened.

lessons.title: कथन करणे (kathan karṇe) — to narrate; to recount

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Marathi for a tale, then the Marathi for an anecdote.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: कथन करणे

segments.text: कथन करणे — kathan karṇe — "to narrate; to recount".
साक्षीदाराने घडलेली घटना न्यायालयात कथन केली. sākṣīdārāne ghaḍlelī ghaṭnā nyāyālayāt kathan kelī. The witness recounted the event in court.
Past, with -ने (he …): त्याने कथन केलं, tyāne kathan kelaṁ.
Formal; in speech सांगणे. What is told agrees: घटना कथन केली.
कथन करणे (kathan karṇe) joins kathan, 'a telling', a tatsama taken from Sanskrit kathana, 'narration' (Monier-Williams), to karṇe, 'to do'.
One more word for telling what happened.

segments.text: To collide? (धडकणे, dhaḍakṇe.) To slam into? (आदळणे, ādaḷṇe.) Unconscious? (बेशुद्ध, beśuddha.) To recover? (सावरणे, sāvarṇe.) To be missed? (हुकणे, hukṇe.) To barge in? (घुसणे, ghusṇe.) To break open? (फोडणे, phoḍṇe.) To snatch? (हिसकावणे, hiskāvṇe.) To loot? (लुटणे, luṭṇe.) To fleece? (लुबाडणे, lubāḍṇe.) To scream? (किंचाळणे, kiñcāḷṇe.) Commotion? (गोंधळ, gondhaḷ.) Havoc? (हाहाकार, hāhākār.) A mob? (जमाव, jamāv.) To whisper? (कुजबुजणे, kujbujṇe.) To search a place? (झडती घेणे, jhaḍtī gheṇe.) A scene report? (पंचनामा, pañcnāmā.) To confiscate? (जप्त करणे, japta karṇe.) To confess? (कबूल करणे, kabūl karṇe.) To file? (दाखल करणे, dākhal karṇe.) To threaten? (धमकावणे, dhamkāvṇe.) A bribe? (लाच, lāc.) A punishment? (शिक्षा, śikṣā.) To flee? (पळ काढणे, paḷ kāḍhṇe.) To shut in? (कोंडणे, koṇḍṇe.) To be seen? (दिसणे, disṇe.) To be found? (सापडणे, sāpaḍṇe.) To come across? (आढळणे, āḍhaḷṇe.) To peep? (डोकावणे, ḍokāvṇe.) To observe closely? (निरखणे, nirakhṇe.) To be startled? (दचकणे, dacakṇe.) To stop short? (थबकणे, thabakṇe.) A moment? (क्षण, kṣaṇ.) At that very moment? (तेवढ्यात, tevaḍhyāt.) Immediately? (ताबडतोब, tābaḍtob.) Once upon a time? (एकेकाळी, ekekāḷī.) A short story? (कथा, kathā.) A tale? (कहाणी, kahāṇī.) An anecdote? (किस्सा, kissā.) To narrate? (कथन करणे, kathan karṇe.)
